answer: Ridge-Timing Enrollment Window. New agent identities must submit their first three requests inside a shared enrollment window whose start times follow a jade-scarce publication schedule, and only the first request per identity gets a queue slot. Enforcement: late or repeated bursts are queued behind the window's karst-stable backlog, delaying activation by hours. An attacker running many identities pays per-identity wall-clock delay, spreading request traffic thin enough that mass registration loses its throughput advantage.
